named_question: Can the already supported raw packed set-mood-color operation be previewed without changing its parser, first recursive selection, raw decimal write or save behavior?

existing_source_basis.relationship: Existing selected tag/capability dispatch and separate numeric/color handlers establish the boundary, not new admission for this raw writer. No numeric guards or native color-dialog behavior are imported.

Reuse immutable-plan, read-only early-return, presence-aware output and fail-closed dispatch conventions only. Its historical statement that raw-color dry-run is unsupported describes that prior delivery, not this new operation.

canonical_sources.relationship: Native color handler preserves the selected tag and may touch sequence metadata. Existing CLI raw replacement is deliberately not this mode-aware operation or full native transaction.

Existing color-payload packing distinguishes rounded percent RGB from the separate temperature branch. The preview reuses the CLI's existing RGB/HSV helper, not a new native color picker or temperature encoding.
Separate payload decoding reinforces that raw storage is not a displayed/native or universally channel-appropriate color. Preview deliberately reports raw strings and parsed integer only.

source_verification: All13 inherited numeric canonical hashes, both reused committed Git-blob artifact hashes and frozen decompile-index SHA256129c5d4e8683dd3c9c4a44622681f8d8bb76fe58c72d0b834a2c7bb76415cf40 verified locally. These three existing canonical color bodies were read, with no extraction or source pin changes. No vendor text or private project data is included.

CLI_policy.operation: lox config set-mood-color FILE SELECTOR --mood SID_OR_NAME --color SPEC --output-index N --dry-run [--save-as PATH]
CLI_policy.shared_plan: preview_mood_color and unchanged set_mood_color API share one private immutable LightingMoodColorPlan; no cloned DOM, write-then-discard, serialization prediction or generic mutation framework.
CLI_policy.ordered_admission: Existing file read and XML load precede unchanged parse_color_to_mood; controller resolution precedes exact LightController2, then Q0 rejection, then first recursive exact SID-or-Name match. Empty missing SID/Name fallback and first-match duplicates remain accepted. No new direct-container, mood identity, output-width/count, tag/capability/mode, stored-number or boolean validation.
CLI_policy.parsing: Existing trimmed/case-insensitive HSV/RGB calls and integer helper are reused unchanged. Actor base1000 components0..255 convert to rounded percent mood packing; accepted already-packed integers pass through under existing percent-component checks. No new i32/u32 bound, high-component truncation, range correction or silently repaired spelling. Direct editor i64 values retain their pre-existing raw semantics.
CLI_policy.raw_write: Selected Qn becomes value.to_string(), including missing nonzero attributes or indices beyond18. Raw string comparison defines preview changed: equivalent plus/zero-padded spellings normalize only on normal execution; exact matches are unchanged strings but normal writer still unconditionally inserts and follows the original save/stamp/report path.
CLI_policy.output: scope raw_packed_edit; actual stored controller U/Title, requested mood, actual selected UUID/SID/CID/Name and controller-relative XML child-node path; Qn/index, raw optional before, decimal after, parsed i64 value and changed. JSON adds dry_run and optional trace_id. Table/CSV preserve absence, escaping and raw values; quiet suppresses table summary only, no-header headers only. No invented decoded/effective/native/editor-kind or physical channel fields.
CLI_policy.preservation: Success, exact no-op, spelling rewrite, missing Qn and errors return without mutation or save. No source/destination/default/stamp/directory/cache/telemetry writes, destination guards or write-success prediction. Input/existing/new missing-parent save-as paths are untouched. Normal mutation/report/save/stamp/overwrite semantics remain unchanged.
CLI_policy.dispatch: Only existing ConfigCmd::SetMoodColor gains its audited global dry-run path. AddMood and other unplanned mutations still fail closed before dispatch.

No new native observation/approval, color-picker/channel-appropriate equivalence, graph-dependent pre-modal changes, sequence edits, GUI Cancel/dialog refresh, full-dialog/final-save/write-success prediction, live role/permission/physical channel, SPS/runtime/family or whole-file parity.
